Third-party files shipped with Cody (so saving a PDF also works offline):

- `jspdf.umd.min.js`: jsPDF 2.5.1, MIT License, (c) James Hall and yWorks GmbH. https://github.com/parallax/jsPDF
- `jspdf.plugin.autotable.min.js`: jsPDF-AutoTable 3.8.2, MIT License, (c) Simon Bengtsson. https://github.com/simonbengtsson/jsPDF-AutoTable
- `three/three.module.min.js` and `three/OrbitControls.js`: three.js r169, MIT License, (c) the three.js authors
  (see `three/THREE-LICENSE.txt`). https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js. Loaded only when a 3D model is shown.
